name: Hulk Account Pages for WooCommerce
author: hulkplugins

sections.description:
Add custom tabs and endpoints to the My Account section of your WooCommerce store using the WooCommerce Account Pages
plugin.

Documentation

Features

  • Easy to use
  • Add unlimited custom pages and endpoints to the My Account section
  • Add Your Own Custom Content to the My Account Area
  • Adjust Content for Different User Roles
  • Familiar Page Editor
  • Shortcode-Friendly
  • Block Editor-Friendly
  • Unlimited Pages
  • Page Ordering
  • WooCommerce Compatible
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation from the WordPress Dashboard

  1. Login to your admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New
  3. Search Hulk Account Pages for WooCommerce
  4. Click install and activate respectively.

Manual Installation from the WordPress Dashboard

If your server is not connected to the Internet, then you can use this method

  1. Download the plugin. A ZIP file will be downloaded.
  2. Login to your site\’s admin panel and navigate to Plugins -> Add New -> Upload.
  3. Click choose file, select the plugin file and click install

Install Using FTP

If you are unable to use any of the methods due to internet connectivity and file permission issues, then you can use
this method

  1. Download the plugin. A ZIP file will be downloaded.
  2. Unzip the file.
  3. Launch your favorite FTP client. Such as FileZilla, FireFTP, CyberDuck etc. If you are a more advanced user, then you
    can use SSH too.
  4. Upload the folder to wp-content/plugins/
  5. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  6. Navigate to Plugins -> Installed
  7. Activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Can you modify the default endpoints for WooCommerce account pages?

This plugin does not allow you to edit the default endpoints on the My Account page. Therefore, sections such as the
dashboard, order history, shipping addresses, and account details will remain unchanged.

However, it does add your new endpoints below these default sections, just above the “Log out” option in the My Account
page sidebar.

Could you edit the design of the “My Account” page using this plugin?

This plugin lacks design settings for your ecommerce store. To customize elements like background color or fonts, you’ll
need to use custom CSS or adjust settings within your theme or page builder.

How can I add a custom page to the WooCommerce account section?

Once installed. To create a new item in the My Account section, go to Account Pages Custom Post Type in the dashboard,
click Add New, enter the content, and hit Publish.
